message.text: I'm tracing the auth flow: the frontend's authInterceptor handles access tokens (kept in-memory/localStorage via auth-state) and refresh tokens (httpOnly cookies), while the backend authenticator manages this on the server side. I want to double-check the auth-state and backend package implementations to confirm this.

args.command: cd /bench/repo && ls server/auth/; echo "=== auth-state ==="; grep -n "export \|localStorage\|sessionStorage" web/src/auth-state.ts | head -25

cd /bench/repo && grep -n "func \|AccessTokenAudience\|RefreshToken\|PAT\|pat\|Bearer" server/auth/authenticator.go | head -30; echo "=== token.go ==="; grep -n "func \|Audience\|const " server/auth/token.go | head -25
